item.text: {"category_edits":[{"category":"learning_objective","rationale":"Add a 0.1-weighted uniform pairwise auxiliary loss to the existing hardness-weighted objective using the same valid positive and negative scores. This may improve ranking while preserving sampling, architecture, inference, optimizer, and training schedule.","edits":[{"find":"    pairwise_loss = torch.nn.functional.softplus(valid_neg - valid_pos)\n    return (weights * pairwise_loss).sum()","replace":"    pairwise_loss = torch.nn.functional.softplus(valid_neg - valid_pos)\n    return (weights * pairwise_loss).sum() + 0.1 * pairwise_loss.mean()"}]}],"change_summary":"Add 0.1 times mean softplus(negative_score - positive_score) to the existing training loss for all four category models. No predictor changes are required."}
